g.title: Actual command dispatch and archive verifier with private package/project roots, real small ZIPs and controlled network responses; tests distinguish preliminary dry-run checks from installed bytes.
Recorded dependencies; execution tooling retains its existing contract owner.

The replacement engine receives a verified candidate file set and mutates selected skill units in a private filesystem; active destinations, unrelated sentinels and retained originals are inspected separately.
Recorded dependencies; execution tooling retains its existing contract owner.
